result:
I would make high-quality education—centered on critical thinking, empathy, and media literacy—universal for every child.

Not because education alone solves everything, but because it equips people to recognize manipulation, understand different perspectives, make better collective decisions, and solve the other problems themselves. It’s a single change that amplifies humanity’s ability to improve everything else.
